conventions.exact_values: strings; identified values were identified at 80 and 120 digits (continued fractions, denominators <= 1e30; PSLQ in Q(sqrt5), coefficients <= 1e10)

U1.group: maximal torus T = {Rz(a) = diag(e^{-ia/2}, e^{ia/2})} (connected, SO(3) image SO(2))
U1.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U2.group: N(T) = T u T.Rx(pi) (Pin(2); SO(3) image O(2))
U2.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U3.group: binary octahedral 2O, order 48 (SO(3) image O, order 24; 4-fold axes z, (1,+-1,0)/sqrt2)
U3.character: sign character of O = S4: -1 on 4-fold rotations and on pi-rotations about 2-fold axes, +1 on 3-fold rotations and on pi-rotations about 4-fold axes; chi(-1) = 1
U3.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U4.group: binary dihedral of order 24 (SO(3) image D6, order 12)
U4.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U5.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U6.group: binary dihedral of order 12 (SO(3) image D3)
U6.action: (r.Phi)(g) = Phi(r^-1 g) = Phi_{sigma, conj(D^3(r)) u}; same for both sectors

U1_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_x Phi), P_W(X_y Phi): infinitesimal rotations about x, y (rotation about z only changes the phase)

U1_sector4.free_directions: P_W(X_x Phi), P_W(X_y Phi): infinitesimal rotations about x, y (rotation about z only changes the phase)

U2_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_x Phi), P_W(X_y Phi): infinitesimal rotations about x, y (rotation about z only changes the phase)

U2_sector4.free_directions: P_W(X_x Phi), P_W(X_y Phi): infinitesimal rotations about x, y (rotation about z only changes the phase)

U3_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations

U3_sector4.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations

U4_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations

U4_sector4.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations

U5_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations (P_W(X_z Phi) is proportional to i e_t)

U5_sector4.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations (P_W(X_z Phi) is proportional to i e_t)

U6_sector3.free_directions: P_W(X_a Phi), a = x, y, z: infinitesimal rotations
